title: merchant.certified.v1
description: A certification run completed and produced a signed, immutable report. Published by Onboarding (BC-3) on pp.merchants.merchant.v1, keyed by merchant_id. Certification is a machine-checked matrix, not a checkbox: for every (gateway, payment method, currency) the merchant enabled, all seven assertions must pass. assertionsPassed == assertionsTotal is the only definition of a pass, and there is no waiver field anywhere in this payload - a waiver is the mechanism by which 'certified' degrades into an opinion.

reportId.description: The sealed report. Immutable once PASSED or FAILED; a re-certification is a new report, never an edit.

environment.description: A sandbox report never certifies a production connection.

suiteVersion.description: Version of the certification suite. Carried so a suite regression can be scoped to the reports it produced.

matrix.description: One entry per (gateway, payment method, currency) cell.

artifactUri.description: Signed, immutable report in object storage under Object Lock.

artifactSha256.description: Digest of the stored object. A mismatch invalidates the report; a consumer must reject rather than trust.

passed.description: True only when all seven assertions passed for this cell. There is no partial pass.
